sentences.text: Milvoides was an extinct genus of accipitrids, a family of birds of prey, that lived during the Eocene epoch.
Fossils of the type species Milvoides kempi have been found in the Selsey Formation of England.
The animal belongs to the genus Milvoides, with Milvoides kempi serving as the type species, the species a genus is based on. Harrison and Walker described this genus in 1979.
This genus lived from 48.07 to 37.71 million years ago, spanning the Lutetian to Bartonian stages.
